title: TopologyV2Edge
description: Topology v2 edge (relationship) between two nodes.

id.description: Stable edge identifier. Prefer a canonical upstream id when one exists (circuit id, link id, session id). Otherwise use a deterministic id derived from endpoints and a discriminator. For undirected edges, sort endpoints to keep the id stable: `edge:<min(fromId,toId)>--<max(fromId,toId)>#<discriminator>` where discriminator can include relation/family/domain/instance or a short hash to distinguish parallel edges.

labels.description: Structured metadata for filtering/grouping and view logic (e.g., labels.relation=connects|contains).

properties.description: Arbitrary rich attributes (numbers, nested objects, arrays).

refs.description: External reference anchors to canonical relationships outside the topology graph (inventory link ids, session ids, cloud attachment ids, etc.). The pair (`type`, `id`) is the reference identity.
